Package org.webharvest.definition

Interface ConfigurableResolver

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractRefreshableResolver, DefinitionResolver
    public interface ConfigurableResolver
    Interface to be implemented by the web harvest configuration elements definition resolvers. Facilitates configuration of resolvers, allowing to register resolver post processors and to register custom web harvest plugins.
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
    Piotr Dyraga, Robert Bala

      • addPostProcessor

        void addPostProcessor​(ResolverPostProcessor postProcessor)
        Adds new ResolverPostProcessor which is going to be applied on the current resolver instance on the resolver refresh.
        Parameters:
        postProcessor - new instance of ResolverPostProcessor; must not be {code null}

      • refresh

        void refresh()
        Refresh the current resolver instance, causing all configuration element definitions to be reinitialized. Also, all previously registered ResolverPostProcessors are invoked.

      • registerPlugin

        void registerPlugin​(ElementInfo elementInfo,
                    String namespace)
        Register provided WebHarvestPlugin based on information provided by specified ElementInfo.
        Parameters:
        elementInfo - web harvest plugin definition needed to succeed registration.
        namespace - XML namespace under which plugin is going to be registered.
